summary.text: Yes, if the MDW is the main caregiver of a person with disability or an elderly person who is a Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident.

details.heading: When MDWs qualify
details.body: An MDW can qualify when they are the main caregiver of a person with disability or an elderly person who is a Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident.
